analytic_checks.reason: Whole-file SHA/length, exact direct_0p1_10 tag, 3200 stored active atoms plus one separate cutoff atom, original family/partition and exact history are required. No current-energy subset of selected_total and no low_cross source is used.

Stored number coefficients [0,A_j] are used as number-density ramp amplitudes; source A is not divided by E. Proper-time/proper-volume Jacobians remain one, preincluded source target density is not multiplied again, and no additional angular/proper729 factor is applied.

New T=100 K H1/He4-only conditional inventory uses the frozen nH/nHe/ne/nb recipe. Donor and recipient inventory/frame/mapping must match. This does not rewrite PR109 nb=null or claim discovery of a complete physical baryon inventory.

New CODATA2022 constants are consistently used. b=4*pi*kappa^2*ne/(me*v*eV_J)*min(log[v*E*eV_J/(kappa*omega)],log[2*E*eV_J/(hbar*omega)]) matches the retained quantum_constant=0 prescription. Positive Coulomb logs are required; this is a prescribed stopping model, not full thermal collision physics.

Native fit thresholds 13.60/24.59 and <=50000 eV are unchanged; H/He d factors are 1/4. Lambda uses ion density in m^-3, velocity in m/s and exactly one 1e-4 conversion from sigma_cm2 to m2. Thermal electron density is not an extra RR target factor. HeI residual-ion ground-channel qualification remains conditional.

d_j=b_j/(E_j-E_previous) with cutoff as predecessor of the first state. P diagonal is 1-(d+lambdaH+lambdaHe)/nu; successor[:-1]+=d[1:]/nu*power[1:] has the required column-oriented downward transition. Nu is nextafter(max exit,+infinity), and negativity/finiteness guards reject invalid chains.

Three backward positive cumulants produce w_k=sum_(n=k+2..M)(n-k-1)p_n/x^2 and v_k=sum_(n=k+3..M)choose(n-k-1,2)p_n/x^3. The last occupancy weight is zero-padded. Production uses t^2*w and t^3*v with the same M and no renormalization.

M-1 count and M-2 occupancy tail thresholds are correct. After F01 repair, reported fractions include the geometric positive remainder. Channel capture uses min(count bound,lambda_max*occupancy bound); kinetic/photon bounds use Emax and Emax+I. Direct-cutoff injection is excluded from the active-source tail. Bin bounds sum endpoint bounds. Ordinary floating-point evaluation is explicitly not an outward enclosure.

The nu=0 branch requires zero rates and returns t^2*A/2 and t^3*A/6; no division by nu occurs. Zero source, one-channel, competing-channel and drift-only synthetic controls are authored. This is a static path inspection, not a claim those controls ran.

analytic_checks.topic: Absolute clock and finite observation bins
analytic_checks.reason: All four prefixes use the same absolute source q(t)=t*A from zero. Bins use differences of actual prefix occupancy and active states, preserving prior survivors. Source integrals use (t1^2-t0^2)/2, not a reset local ramp. T endpoint is labelled known-history left limit; outside [0,T] remains unknown.

A_cutoff is not appended to the active RR state. Direct cutoff is analytic A_cutoff*(t1^2-t0^2)/2; drift cutoff is d_0*O_0. Both carry cutoff energy 0.1 eV. Coulomb reward sum b_j*O_j equals drift step-energy losses for the discrete model.

Per-atom capture lambda_cj*O_j yields N, captured kinetic E_j*N_j, retained photon (E_j+I_c)*N_j and binding change -I_c*N. Count, kinetic and total energy closures include active changes, both cutoff sources and Coulomb caloric reward. Actual atom arrays are exported; photons are not inferred from only aggregate moments.

One source birth claim and disjoint channel/bin claims use the physical source family, birth support and time intervals. Cumulative prefixes are nonadditive and cannot claim returns. Same-family overlapping birth/return intervals are rejected independently of producer revision. This specialized registry presumes the frozen admitted history/context and is not a universal merge of unrelated source histories.

H1I/H1II indices 1/2 and He4I/He4II 10/11 receive opposite capture/nb; zeta21=-(CH+CHe)/nb, w_nt22=-(KH+KHe)*eV_J/nb, w_ext23=0 and logT24=0 frozen diagnostic. Delta nb=0 for these captures and q.DeltaY-Delta zeta=0. Source parent-ion chemistry, full_source_native25 and coupled state update remain null.

Closure and native thermal-electron residual targets are 1e-11; source-tail targets 1e-13; positive channel N/K/photon tail targets 1e-12 relative to each channel value. Independent reference target is 1e-9 and remains pending. No outward rounding, continuous-energy/model error bound, physical heating or global completion is asserted.

findings.title: Include unadded positive Poisson-tail remainder in bound fields
findings.finding: positive_tail returned a subtotal tc/to and separate geometric upper remainder rc/ro; old tail fraction fields consumed only the subtotal while calling it an analytic upper bound.
findings.impact: By the authored stop rule the omitted positive remainder is <=1e-65 times the subtotal. No numerical failure or effect on the frozen tolerances has been measured; the issue was the precise upper-bound accounting.
findings.repair: Bound fields now use tc+rc and to+ro, while new poisson_tail_subtotal_*_decimal fields retain tc/to for phi mass-identity diagnostics. Existing remainder records, no-renormalization behavior, and ordinary-float/non-outward warning remain.
findings.verification: Author change inspected as text and final file SHA checked; no import, compile, numerical run or extra test.
